books.title: Small Boat
books.author: Vincent Delecroix
books.why: A sinking in the Channel, told by the coastguard who took the calls. Responsibility passes from one side to the other while the boat goes down.

books.title: Animal Farm
books.author: George Orwell
books.why: The commandments are rewritten on the barn wall, and the animals repeat the new version as if it had always been there.

patterns.name: The performative shift (Yurchak's late Soviet 'loyalty theatre')

books.title: The Trees
books.author: Percival Everett
books.why: A comedy about lynching. It breaks a sacred taboo on purpose, and the discomfort is the argument.

books.title: The Wretched of the Earth
books.author: Frantz Fanon
books.why: Colonial rule and the resistance to it, each side’s response hardening the other.

books.title: Yellowface
books.author: R.F. Kuang
books.why: One stolen manuscript, then a pen name, then a career built on it. Each step makes the next feel normal.

books.title: This House of Grief
books.author: Helen Garner
books.why: A father’s car goes into a dam with his three sons inside. In court, every earlier detail is reread as a warning.

books.title: Unmasking the Face
books.author: Paul Ekman
books.verdict: Evidence check: Ekman’s universal emotions are contested.

books.title: The Criminal Mind
books.author: Duncan Harding
books.why: Read it with one question running: how much is the person, and how much the situation they were in?

books.title: A Doll’s House
books.author: Henrik Ibsen
books.why: A marriage kept because it is the arrangement, until Nora decides it doesn’t have to be.

books.title: The Handmaid’s Tale
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.why: Everyone in Gilead says the right words. Almost nobody believes them, and everyone acts as if they do.

patterns.name: The performative shift (Yurchak's late Soviet 'loyalty theatre')

books.title: Fahrenheit 451
books.author: Ray Bradbury
books.why: A society that burns the evidence rather than change its mind.
